I agree with all verdicts; the Router was not too lenient but appropriately strict regarding visibility.

The topology auditor found a clean mask (0.95 confidence), contradicting severe fusion. I agree with the Router's moderate severity assessment; the artifacts are subtle and do not constitute catastrophic failure.
